page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 16 dedicated vCPUs provided by an AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. It is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The configuration does not feature dedicated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, positioning it strictly for non-accelerated, network-attached workloads.

The dedicated AMD EPYC processor allocation provides predictable compute performance without resource sharing. The 1:4 resource density offers a balanced profile for general-purpose workloads, avoiding the premium costs associated with memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances. This hardware profile is suited for application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized database hosting where local storage is not a prerequisite.
